Test Objective: Assess least-privilege design for selected identities
Procedure: Select a risk-based sample of privileged and workload roles; inspect attached and inline policies, trust relationships and business approvals; identify wildcard or high-impact permissions and validate documented need.
Expected Result: Permissions align to approved duties; exceptions are justified, approved and reviewed.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Unexplained broad permissions, unused privileged access, unapproved role trust or missing owner/approval.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted policy export, sample list, reviewer notes, exception references

Test Objective: Verify strong authentication and privileged access path
Procedure: Trace the human administrator access path; inspect MFA enforcement and role trust settings; review emergency access controls and test only in an authorized lab.
Expected Result: Privileged human access follows approved strong-authentication and role-assumption controls.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Privileged access path bypasses required authentication, has overly broad trust or emergency access is ungoverned.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted configuration, test steps, result and exceptions

Procedure: Inventory public IPs/endpoints and inspect relevant routes, load balancer listeners and security-group rules; compare each exposure to approved requirements.
Expected Result: Only documented, required services are exposed; management and data services are not unintentionally public.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Unapproved public endpoint, broad ingress without justification or exposed management/data service.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted network exports, endpoint list and approved-flow comparison

Procedure: Review architecture and rules; in an authorized lab, test approved and denied paths between entry, application, data and admin tiers.
Expected Result: Only documented flows are allowed; prohibited paths fail as expected.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Unexpected connectivity between zones or no evidence supporting the claimed segmentation.
Evidence to Retain: Diagram, relevant rule extracts and connectivity test results

Test Objective: Verify CloudTrail coverage for required scope
Procedure: Inspect trail or event data store status, account/region coverage, management-event settings and destinations; generate a safe test management event in a lab and trace it to logs.
Expected Result: Required activity is recorded in the intended scope and reaches the approved destination.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Required account/region or event coverage missing, logging disabled, or test event absent without explanation.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted configuration and test event reference

Procedure: Inspect destination permissions, administrative roles, encryption and retention settings; compare with policy; verify who can change or delete records.
Expected Result: Log access and retention follow approved requirements and are separated from routine workload administration where designed.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Unapproved principals can alter/delete logs, retention is inadequate, or configuration conflicts with policy.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted policy/configuration extracts and policy comparison

Test Objective: Verify selected security alert delivery and ownership
Procedure: Review alarm definitions and routing; trigger an approved test alarm or use an existing test record; inspect acknowledgement and incident/ticket evidence.
Expected Result: Test alert reaches the intended recipient, has an owner and follows the response procedure.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Alert fails to deliver, has no accountable owner, or no evidence shows expected response.
Evidence to Retain: Alarm configuration, test timestamp and ticket reference

Test Objective: Assess configuration recording and drift visibility
Procedure: Inspect AWS Config recorder status and resource coverage, review selected rules/history, and compare a sampled resource to its approved baseline.
Expected Result: In-scope supported resources are recorded and relevant deviations are visible and triaged.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Recording gaps, material resources excluded without approval, or identified drift lacks triage.
Evidence to Retain: Recorder/rule exports, sampled resource and finding references

Procedure: Sample changes and follow request, review/approval, pipeline execution, deployment identity and post-change validation.
Expected Result: Changes are authorized, traceable and deployed through approved paths; exceptions are recorded.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Unreviewed or untraceable production change, uncontrolled deployment privilege or missing required approval.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted PR/ticket/deployment references and test notes

Procedure: Inspect metadata and approved secret-scan results; verify use of roles or managed storage where applicable; review rotation records without retrieving or publishing secret values.
Expected Result: Secrets are not exposed in code or logs; access is restricted; unnecessary long-lived credentials are removed or governed.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Live secret exposed, unexplained long-lived access key, missing rotation after exposure or excessive secret-store access.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted scan results, metadata and rotation ticket

Procedure: Select critical assets; trace backup coverage and latest restore test; compare actual results with approved recovery objectives.
Expected Result: Critical assets are covered and restoration is demonstrated within approved objectives or gaps are accepted and tracked.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Missing backup, failed/untested restoration, or recovery gap without an approved treatment plan.
Evidence to Retain: Backup report, restore test and owner sign-off

Procedure: Sample critical/high findings and exceptions; check owner, due date, escalation, implementation evidence, repeat-test result and residual-risk approval.
Expected Result: Findings remain tracked through validated closure or documented, authorized risk acceptance.
Failure or Exception Criteria: Unowned/overdue finding without escalation, unsupported closure, or unauthorized risk acceptance.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted tracker entries and closure evidence references
